product.name: AI-Powered Deduction Management Service
product.description: An AI-driven platform that automates the tracking, categorization, dispute resolution, and reconciliation of retailer and distributor deductions for CPG brands.

product.name: Automated Categorization
product.description: AI technology that imports and categorizes distributor deductions in real-time, extracting relevant details for visibility and management.

product.name: AI Dispute Engine
product.description: A platform feature that identifies invalid deductions and manages the dispute process on behalf of CPG brands until recovery.

product.name: Integrated Reconciliation
product.description: Integration with accounting software to map deductions to charts of accounts and streamline credit memo reconciliation.
